heading: Assistance for governmental entities and private entities in recognizing online violent extremist content

tree.heading: Assistance to recognize online violent extremist content
tree.text: Not later than 180 days after May 5, 2017, and consistent with the protection of intelligence sources and methods, the Director of National Intelligence shall publish on a publicly available Internet website a list of all logos, symbols, insignia, and other markings commonly associated with, or adopted by, an organization designated by the Secretary of State as a foreign terrorist organization under section 1189(a) of title 8.

tree.heading: Updates
tree.text: The Director shall update the list published under subsection (a) every 180 days until December 22, 2023.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2023—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 118–31 substituted “until December 22, 2023” for “or more frequently as needed”.
